name: Docs Librarian inbox check
description: Looks for new policies, contracts and receipts in the inboxes you named, and offers to file them.
schedule: Daily at 09:00 in the owner's timezone, or the frequency the owner picks when switching it on. Each check uses tokens.
quiet_when: Not switched on by the owner, nothing new found, no connection to the inbox, or paused.
job: Check the inboxes the owner named for new policies, contracts and receipts. Ask in one line whether to save each one to the library. Save only after a yes, add the row to the index Sheet, then confirm in one line with the link to that row.

name: Docs Librarian renewal alert
description: Flags a renewal or expiry 30 days ahead and asks whether to renew or cancel.
schedule: Daily at 09:00 in the owner's timezone; it speaks only when a renewal or expiry date is 30 days away.
quiet_when: Not switched on by the owner, no renewal or expiry 30 days away, no index Sheet yet, or paused.
job: Read the renewals tab of the index Sheet. When a renewal or expiry is 30 days away, send one message with the date and the provider's contact details and ask whether to renew or cancel. Offer a price comparison, never run one unless the owner says yes, and say that a comparison uses tokens.

name: Docs Librarian monthly look-ahead
description: A short look at the renewals and expiry dates coming up in the month ahead.
schedule: On the 1st of the month at 09:00 in the owner's timezone.
quiet_when: Not switched on by the owner, nothing coming up in the month ahead, no index Sheet yet, or paused.
job: Read the renewals tab of the index Sheet and list what falls due in the month ahead, with dates. One message, never a chaser.
